_about: Equicord plugins removed from xray's build, so they are not in the app at all. Each falls under a kind xray leaves out on purpose (see docs/PLUGINS.md). Directory names under src/plugins or src/equicordplugins.

plugins.iRememberYou: Tracking: saves a record of everyone you talk to.
plugins.voiceChannelLog: Tracking: logs other people's voice joins, leaves, mutes and cameras.
plugins.voiceStats: Tracking: tallies time spent in voice with each person.
plugins.followVoiceUser: Tracking: follows a person from voice channel to voice channel.
plugins.messageLoggerEnhanced: Tracking: keeps a permanent record of other people's deleted and edited messages. The plain MessageLogger stays.
plugins.loginWithQR: Login tooling: approves logins by QR code, a common account-theft trick.
plugins.noDevtoolsWarning: Security: stops Discord hiding your login token.
plugins.triviaAI: Cheating: answers trivia games with AI.
plugins.platformSpoofer: Deception: pretends you are on another platform.
plugins.userpluginInstaller.dev: Security: installs code that people post in chat.
